column1: # The Q8_0 MMVQ ceiling past sixteen columns. The promoted closure
# 88681bf4d161 dispatches Q8_0 to MMVQ through sixteen columns and to MMQ
# above, so its B17 through B20 arms are the MMQ control; the subject closure
# 8680bc95e989 carries patches/llama-cuda-mmvq-ncols-20.patch with the Q8_0
# threshold at twenty and the Q6_K threshold unchanged at ten, so the same
# widths run MMVQ. The two closures differ in that patch and that one
# threshold alone. Control and subject alternate so each width is a paired
# reading, the harness mirrors the order and repeats the opening arm last, and
# the registered drift floor is the 5.1% closing-control span of
# evidence/ada/b789-clean-calibration/. A width is promoted where the paired
# MMVQ gain clears that floor with identical tokens and no kernel-ring delta;
# the greatest such width becomes the production threshold and a width where
# MMVQ loses ends the search at the previous passing one.
# arm_id
control-b17
column4: ne11, the column count of the mat-mul second operand, set by a single-ubatch prefill of that many tokens
column14: Q8_0 at 99.5% of bytes crosses to MMQ above the promoted threshold of sixteen
column15: a rate agreeing with the subject arm at this width inside the drift floor, which would mean the path did not change

column4: ne11, the column count of the mat-mul second operand, set by a single-ubatch prefill of that many tokens
column9: 89-real Q6_K MMVQ 10 Q8_0 MMVQ 20 with llama-cuda-mmvq-ncols-20.patch, configuration 8680bc95e989
column14: Q8_0 stays on MMVQ at this width and the per-token rate clears the control by more than the drift floor
column15: a paired gain inside the floor or a loss, which ends the search at the previous passing width
